has_next.description: Whether or not the list of case results has reached the end.

last_sequence_id.description: If has_next is true, the last_sequence_id is the token that should accompany the next request to get the following page of results.

limit.description: The maximum number of case results to retrieve per page.

answer_class.description: The answer class for the case.

n_qualified_opinions.description: The number of qualified opinions supporting the answer class (i.e. classification opinions including it, or segmentation/range opinions including a finding of the answer class).

sum_confidence_scores.description: The sum of confidence scores (each between 0 and 1) of the supporting opinions for the answer class.

agreement.description: The agreement between labeler opinions on the answer class.

difficulty.description: The difficulty of the answer class on the content element being labeled.

task_type.description: The labeling task (e.g. choice, box, circle, etc.)

content_type.description: The content type of the task (e.g. image, video, etc.)

labeling_state.description: The labeling state of the case (e.g. Labeled, Gold Standard, etc.)

n_qualified_opinions.description: The number of qualified opinions collected for the case.

prelabel.description: The pre-label for the content element.  Included for non-classification tasks only.

correct_annotation.description: The correct annotation for the content element being labeled.

combined_opinion.description: The combined opinion for the content element based on labeler opinions.

correct_annotation_classes.description: The correct answer classes for the content element being labeled.  Included for classification tasks only.

combined_opinion_classes.description: The answer classes for the combined opinion for the content element.  Included for classification tasks only.

agreement.description: The agreement between labeler opinions on the content element within the case.

difficulty.description: The difficulty of the content element within the case.

answer_class_stats.description: The opinion statistics for each answer class in the case.

top_reads.description: The list of top labeler opinions used to create the combined opinion for the case. Included for non-cuboid task types.

read_id.description: An identifier for the labeler opinion.

user_id.description: The ID of the labeler who submitted the opinion.

qscore.description: The confidence level of the user opinion.

patch.description: An identifier for the patch within the image.

comments.description: Comments submitted by users on the case.

flags.description: Messages submitted by users who flagged the case.

static_highlight_ranges.description: Range and text for static highlighted ranges

text.description: The text for the static highlighted range

answer_class.description: The label class within the answer (correct annotation, combined opinion, or labeler opinion).

is_correct.description: Whether the answer includes the class. Included for classification tasks only.

geometries.description: The segmentation for the answer class in WKT format. Included for contour segmentation tasks only.

mask.description: A pre-signed URL to the segmentation for the answer class in mask (TIFF binary array) format. Included for mask segmentation tasks only.

ranges.description: The integer ranges for the answer class. Included for range tasks only.

entities.description: The entities for the answer class. Included for NER tasks only.

freetexts.description: An array of freetexts with one entry (array or null) per finding.

items.description: An array of freetexts for one specific finding. May contain 0, 1, or multiple text entries.

origin.description: An identifier for the file origin of the content.

series.description: An identifier for the series that the content belongs to.

series_index.description: The index of the content within the series (if any) that it belongs to.

dicom_study_uid.description: The DICOM study UID of the content.

dicom_series_uid.description: The DICOM series UID of the content.

dicom_instance_uid.description: The DICOM instance UID of the content.
